mapper.select: SELECT table_schema FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = 'ora_tablespace_info' AND table_schema NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema','public','insp') AND table_name NOT SIMILAR TO '%_p[0-9]+' ORDER BY table_schema
SELECT db_id, instance_name, business_name FROM public.apm_db_info ORDER BY db_id
SELECT db_id, instance_name, business_name FROM apm_db_info ORDER BY db_id

SELECT sn.service_id, sn.name AS service_name, f.db_id, f.instance_name FROM public.ora_service_name sn JOIN public.ora_service_info si ON si.service_id = sn.service_id JOIN public.apm_db_info f ON f.db_id = si.db_id ORDER BY sn.service_id, f.instance_name

SELECT sn.service_id, sn.name AS service_name, f.db_id, f.instance_name FROM ora_service_name sn JOIN ora_service_info si ON si.service_id = sn.service_id JOIN apm_db_info f ON f.db_id = si.db_id ORDER BY sn.service_id, f.instance_name

WITH latest AS ( SELECT MAX(time) AS max_time FROM ${schema}.ora_tablespace_info WHERE db_id = #{dbId} ), snap AS ( SELECT tablespace_name AS ts_name, SUM(ROUND(total_space/1073741824.0, 2)) AS total_gb, SUM(ROUND(total_space/1073741824.0, 2) - ROUND(free_space/1073741824.0, 2)) AS used_gb FROM ${schema}.ora_tablespace_info, latest WHERE db_id = #{dbId} AND time = latest.max_time GROUP BY tablespace_name ), w1 AS ( SELECT tablespace_name AS ts_name, SUM(ROUND(total_space/1073741824.0, 2) - ROUND(free_space/1073741824.0, 2)) AS used_gb FROM ${schema}.ora_tablespace_info WHERE db_id = #{dbId} AND time = ( SELECT MAX(time) FROM ${schema}.ora_tablespace_info WHERE db_id = #{dbId} AND time <= (SELECT max_time - INTERVAL '7 days' FROM latest) ) GROUP BY tablespace_name ), m1 AS ( SELECT tablespace_name AS ts_name, SUM(ROUND(total_space/1073741824.0, 2) - ROUND(free_space/1073741824.0, 2)) AS used_gb FROM ${schema}.ora_tablespace_info WHERE db_id = #{dbId} AND time = ( SELECT MAX(time) FROM ${schema}.ora_tablespace_info WHERE db_id = #{dbId} AND time <= (SELECT max_time - INTERVAL '30 days' FROM latest) ) GROUP BY tablespace_name ) SELECT s.ts_name, COALESCE(s.total_gb, 0) AS total_gb, COALESCE(s.used_gb, 0) AS used_gb, CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.total_gb, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(w1.used_gb, s.used_gb) / s.total_gb * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END AS used_pct_1w, CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.total_gb, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(m1.used_gb, s.used_gb) / s.total_gb * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END AS used_pct_1m FROM snap s LEFT JOIN w1 ON w1.ts_name = s.ts_name LEFT JOIN m1 ON m1.ts_name = s.ts_name WHERE s.total_gb > 0 ORDER BY s.used_gb DESC

WITH latest AS ( SELECT MAX(time) AS max_time FROM ora_tablespace_info WHERE db_id = #{dbId} ), snap AS ( SELECT tablespace_name AS ts_name, SUM(ROUND(total_space/1073741824, 2)) AS total_gb, SUM(ROUND(total_space/1073741824, 2) - ROUND(free_space/1073741824, 2)) AS used_gb FROM ora_tablespace_info, latest WHERE db_id = #{dbId} AND time = latest.max_time GROUP BY tablespace_name ), w1 AS ( SELECT tablespace_name AS ts_name, SUM(ROUND(total_space/1073741824, 2) - ROUND(free_space/1073741824, 2)) AS used_gb FROM ora_tablespace_info WHERE db_id = #{dbId} AND time = ( SELECT MAX(time) FROM ora_tablespace_info WHERE db_id = #{dbId} AND time <= (SELECT max_time - INTERVAL '7' DAY FROM latest) ) GROUP BY tablespace_name ), m1 AS ( SELECT tablespace_name AS ts_name, SUM(ROUND(total_space/1073741824, 2) - ROUND(free_space/1073741824, 2)) AS used_gb FROM ora_tablespace_info WHERE db_id = #{dbId} AND time = ( SELECT MAX(time) FROM ora_tablespace_info WHERE db_id = #{dbId} AND time <= (SELECT max_time - INTERVAL '30' DAY FROM latest) ) GROUP BY tablespace_name ) SELECT s.ts_name AS ts_name, NVL(s.total_gb, 0) AS total_gb, NVL(s.used_gb, 0) AS used_gb, CASE WHEN NVL(s.total_gb, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(NVL(w1.used_gb, s.used_gb) / s.total_gb * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END AS used_pct_1w, CASE WHEN NVL(s.total_gb, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(NVL(m1.used_gb, s.used_gb) / s.total_gb * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END AS used_pct_1m FROM snap s LEFT JOIN w1 ON w1.ts_name = s.ts_name LEFT JOIN m1 ON m1.ts_name = s.ts_name WHERE NVL(s.total_gb, 0) > 0 ORDER BY s.used_gb DESC
